scenario.title: Late shipments
scenario.initial_request: Build a chatbot that tells customers why their parcel is late

F-01.statement: Median pickup delay is 2.0 hours based on 60 pickups

F-02.statement: 300 out of 1000 orders are late at handover stage (30% late)

F-03.statement: Batch release job RELEASE-BATCH had 21 failed runs out of 30 and released 290 orders after pickup

CL-01.statement: Build a chatbot that tells customers why their parcel is late

CL-02.statement: The carrier picks up two hours late, that's why parcels are late.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The observation shows that the median pickup delay is 2.0 hours across 60 pickups, indicating a measurable delay at the pickup stage.
30% of orders are late at the handover stage, indicating a significant lateness issue at that point in the process.

E-03.content: The carrier picks up two hours late, that's why parcels are late.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder attributes parcel lateness to the carrier picking up two hours late, indicating a carrier-side delay as a cause of lateness.
The batch release job RELEASE-BATCH failed in 21 out of 30 runs (70% failure) and 290 orders were released after pickup, indicating a problematic release process that could contribute to lateness.

E-05.content: Carrier contract §3: pickup schedule changes run after SH-CAR confirms.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The carrier contract states that pickup schedule changes only proceed after SH-CAR confirms, indicating the carrier has authority to approve or delay pickup timing.

U-01.question: What is the quantitative relationship between pickup delay duration and handover lateness probability?
U-01.resolution_path: Collect paired timestamps of pickup completion and handover for a representative sample of orders to compute correlation/regression.
U-01.safe_placeholder: Deploy an operational alert that flags when median pickup delay exceeds 2.0 hours, prompting manual review without changing schedules.

U-02.question: Do release batch failures contribute independently to order lateness beyond pickup delay?
U-02.resolution_path: Analyze release_batch run outcomes alongside handover lateness per order to assess any residual effect.
U-02.safe_placeholder: Maintain current release process while monitoring its impact on lateness metrics.

A-A1.statement: The median pickup delay of 2.0 hours is representative of the delay experienced by orders that become late.

A-A2.statement: Handover lateness is primarily driven by pickup delay rather than other downstream processes.
